purpose: EC3 published GWP per KILOGRAM for the records of the frozen ECC extract. Used ONLY by empirical.internally_inconsistent, to test whether a record declared per volume, area or length implies a physically impossible mass. Frozen so the arm stays reproducible from a clean clone; the live store has moved on and its sha256 no longer matches the one the ECC extract records.
note: Pulled from a LATER snapshot of the store than the ECC extract. That is acceptable for a consistency check on a per-EPD constant, and records absent from this file are simply not checked.
